# Pages

## Home page

The home screen is shown to the user when they open the tool. It features a
piece of welcome text, introducing the user to the site and guiding them to the
various functionalities.

Components:

- [Top bar menu](#top-bar-menu)
- Welcome text

Welcome text example:
```txt
Welcome to the ODM Validation web tool.

Here you can upload and validate your ODM compliant datasets.

See [tutorials] for more info.
```

# UI Components

## Top bar menu

This is the main-menu bar at the top of every page.

Menu items:

- Upload dataset
- Datasets: *list of datasets*
- View validation profiles
- Tutorials

Behavior:

1.  The bar should be fixed to the top of the screen. Even if the user
    scrolls, the position of the bar should not change.
2.  When the user clicks on the **Upload Dataset** button, the
    [Choose dataset dialog](#choose-dataset-dialog) dialog should be opened.
4.  When the user clicks on the **Datasets** button, a dropdown should
    be opened that lists all the datasets that the user has uploaded.
    The dropdown should be closed when the user clicks on any part of
    the app again.
    1.  Each dataset should be presented to the user using its file
        name.
    2.  When the user clicks on a dataset, it should be selected, and
        the user taken to the **View Dataset** screen. The dropdown
        should be closed.
    3.  When the user has not uploaded any datasets, the dropdown should
        only have one item that says **No Datasets Uploaded**.
5.  When the user clicks on the **View Validation Profiles** button, the
    [View validation profiles dialog](#view-validation-profiles-dialog) should
    be opened.
6.  The **Tutorials** button can be disabled for now.
